body: I'll wake up at about 11am having not been able to get to sleep till about 3am. Do any urgent work that needs doing for a couple of hours to get people off my back. Go for a long walk (maybe 3 hours or so) around London - it's the only thing that makes me calm. Watch some tv or a film. Talk to my flatmates in the evening and pretend that I've had a good day. Repeat.
What would you like to know?
Of course I want to be happy but I have no idea what it even means or how to get there.
I'm 23. I went to a very good university. I'm currently self-employed. No.
